_comment: W6+SH probe rung 3 — SBC S-basis completion.
Same rung-1 finding (one extra near-null, a uniform PB|*|L2W common mode).
network.sbasis_complete is the knob built for precisely this signature: it
derives the REALIZED S-basis dimension pre-gate and constrains the
observed-beyond-declared directions along their own eigenvectors at the
carried level, instead of withholding the epoch.  Its documented origin is the
FT63 GPS+Gal observed-4-vs-declared-2 case; this is observed-2-vs-declared-1,
the same class one dimension down.  If the direction really is a gauge, this
is the CORRECT remedy — pin it — rather than reclassifying it as informative.
